title_play.note: The big button on the title screen. Pressing it starts or continues the game.

play_pause.note: The corner button while playing. Pressing it pauses the game. Read aloud by screen readers.

play_move.note: Name of the on-screen move stick on touch screens. Read aloud by screen readers.

paused_resume.note: Button on the pause menu. Closes the menu and goes back to the game.

paused_close.note: The X on the pause menu. Closes the menu. Not the same word as Resume, so screen readers hear one Resume button.

paused_back.note: The X when the menu is showing a question (leave the game, or progress changed). Goes back one step.

paused_mute.note: Button on the pause menu. Turns all sound off.

paused_unmute.note: Button on the pause menu when sound is off. Turns sound back on.

paused_settings.note: Button on the pause menu. Opens the Settings screen.

paused_quit.note: Button on the pause menu. Asks to leave the game and go to the title screen.

paused_quit_prompt.note: The question after pressing Back to menu. Warns that progress not saved is lost.

paused_quit_confirm.note: Button under the leave question. Leaves the game for good.

paused_cancel.note: Button under the leave question. Cancels and keeps playing.

paused_reconnect.note: Shown when the game paused because the controller in use was unplugged. Tells the player to plug it back in.

settings_screen_back.note: Button on the Settings screen. Goes back to the menu it came from.

settings_screen_tabs.note: Name of the row of tabs on the Settings screen. Read aloud by screen readers.

settings_screen_settings_tab.note: Tab on the Settings screen. Shows sound, display and language.

settings_screen_controls_tab.note: Tab on the Settings screen. Shows the buttons and keys, and lets the player change them.

settings_screen_more.note: Says how many more items are hidden in a long list. {count} is a number.

settings_prompts_unbound.note: Shown beside an action that has no button yet.

settings_prompts_touch.note: Name of the touch screen's way of pressing a button.

settings_prompts_pad_bottom.note: Controller button name: the bottom one of the four face buttons.

settings_prompts_pad_right.note: Controller button name: the right one of the four face buttons.

settings_prompts_pad_left.note: Controller button name: the left one of the four face buttons.

settings_prompts_pad_top.note: Controller button name: the top one of the four face buttons.

settings_prompts_pad_left_bumper.note: Controller button name: the shoulder button on the left.

settings_prompts_pad_right_bumper.note: Controller button name: the shoulder button on the right.

settings_prompts_pad_left_trigger.note: Controller button name: the trigger on the left.

settings_prompts_pad_right_trigger.note: Controller button name: the trigger on the right.

settings_prompts_pad_select.note: Controller button name: the Select (or Back) button.

settings_prompts_pad_start.note: Controller button name: the Start (or Menu) button.

settings_prompts_pad_left_stick.note: Controller button name: pressing down on the left stick.

settings_prompts_pad_right_stick.note: Controller button name: pressing down on the right stick.

settings_prompts_pad_home.note: Controller button name: the Home (or Guide) button.

settings_controls_keyboard.note: Name of the keyboard column in the controls list.

settings_controls_gamepad.note: Name of the controller column in the controls list.

settings_controls_touch.note: Name of the touch screen column in the controls list.

settings_controls_in_use.note: Marks the device the player is using right now.

settings_controls_reset.note: Button in the controls list. Puts every button back to how the game had it. Asks nothing first.

settings_controls_press.note: Shown while waiting for the player to press the new button or key.

settings_controls_rebind.note: Read aloud on a button that changes one action on one device. {action} is the action, {device} the device.

settings_controls_capturing.note: Read aloud while waiting for a new button. {device} is the device, {action} the action, {seconds} the seconds left.

settings_controls_conflict.note: Said when the chosen button is already used. {other} is the action that uses it, {action} the one being changed.

settings_controls_reserved.note: Said when the chosen button is kept for the menus. {action} is the action being changed.

settings_controls_timed_out.note: Said when no button was pressed in time. {action} is the action that stays as it was.

settings_controls_saved.note: Said after a new button was chosen. {action} is the action.

settings_language_automatic.note: Choice in the language list. Uses the language the device is set to.

settings_vibration_toggle.note: Switch that turns controller rumble and phone vibration on or off.

settings_vibration_on.note: Word on the vibration switch when it is on.

settings_vibration_off.note: Word on the vibration switch when it is off.

settings_audio_mute.note: Switch that turns all sound off.

settings_audio_mute_unfocused.note: Switch. When on, sound stops while the player is in another app or tab.

settings_audio_on.note: Word on a sound switch when it is on.

settings_audio_off.note: Word on a sound switch when it is off.

settings_audio_buses_master.note: Name of the slider for every sound at once.

settings_audio_buses_music.note: Name of the slider for music.

settings_audio_buses_sfx.note: Name of the slider for sound effects.

settings_audio_buses_ui.note: Name of the slider for menu clicks and sounds.

settings_audio_buses_voice.note: Name of the slider for voices.

settings_audio_percent.note: The value next to a volume slider. {percent} is a number from 0 to 100.

settings_audio_unavailable.note: Shown when sound could not start on this device.

settings_audio_host_volume.note: Shown under the sound sliders. Tells the player the device's own volume still matters.

settings_touch_title.note: Heading of the touch controls section.

settings_touch_mode.note: Label of the choice of how to play on a touch screen.

settings_display_quality.note: Label of the choice of picture quality.

settings_display_qualities_high.note: Choice of picture quality: the best.

settings_display_qualities_medium.note: Choice of picture quality: in between.

settings_display_qualities_low.note: Choice of picture quality: the lightest, for slow devices.

settings_display_reduced_motion_on.note: Says the device is set to reduce motion, so the game moves less.

settings_display_reduced_motion_off.note: Says the device is not set to reduce motion.

saves_slots_title.note: Heading of the list of saved games.

saves_slots_loading.note: Shown while the saved games are being read.

saves_slots_slot.note: Name of one save slot. {number} is its number, starting at 1.

saves_slots_empty.note: Shown on a save slot that has nothing in it.

saves_slots_unreadable.note: Shown on a save slot that cannot be read.

saves_slots_newer.note: Shown on a save made by a newer version of the game.

saves_slots_other_content.note: Shown on a save made by another version. It still loads, but some things may reset.

saves_slots_writing.note: Shown while a save is being written.

saves_slots_failed.note: Shown when saving did not work.

saves_slots_load.note: Button on a save slot that has a game. Loads it and carries on playing.

saves_slots_new_game.note: Button on a save slot. Starts a new game in it.

saves_slots_delete.note: Button on a save slot. Opens a question before anything is deleted.

saves_slots_delete_title.note: Heading of the question before a save is deleted.

saves_slots_delete_body.note: Text of the delete question. {name} is the slot's name.

saves_slots_delete_newer_body.note: Text of the delete question for a save made by a newer version of the game.

saves_slots_delete_confirm.note: Button under the delete question. Deletes the save for good.

saves_slots_cancel.note: Button under the delete question. Keeps the save.

saves_slots_more.note: Says how many more save slots are hidden in a long list. {count} is a number.

saves_status_checking.note: Shown while the game checks the player's saved progress.

saves_status_syncing.note: Shown while progress is being saved.

saves_status_saved.note: Shown when progress has been saved.

saves_status_offline_queued.note: Shown when there is no internet. Progress will be saved when the connection is back.

saves_status_retry.note: Shown when saving failed once and the game will try again by itself.

saves_status_conflict.note: Shown when two different saved progresses exist and the player must pick one.

saves_status_recovered.note: Shown when saved progress was brought back.

saves_status_no_grant.note: Shown when this place does not allow the game to keep progress.

saves_changed_elsewhere_message.note: Text of the question when progress changed on another device. The player loads it or plays on and the next save replaces it.

saves_changed_elsewhere_load_newer.note: Button under the changed-progress question. Loads the newer progress.

saves_changed_elsewhere_keep_playing.note: Button under the changed-progress question. Keeps playing as before.

saves_changed_elsewhere_failed.note: Shown when the newer progress could not be loaded. The game goes on as it was.

saves_changed_elsewhere_toast.note: A short message at the top of the screen when progress changed on another device.

board_title.note: Heading of the high scores list.

board_loading.note: Shown while the scores are being fetched.

board_empty.note: Shown when the scores list has nothing in it.

board_unavailable.note: Shown when this place has no scores.

board_offline.note: Shown when there is no internet, so scores cannot be fetched.

board_you.note: Marks the player's own row in the scores list.

board_more.note: Says how many more scores are hidden in a long list. {count} is a number.

pad_unsupported.note: Told once when a controller the game does not support is plugged in.

runtime_start.note: Shown when the game could not start. A button lets the player try again.

runtime_start_final.note: Shown when the game could not start and trying again will not help.

runtime_connect.note: Shown when the game could not reach Ruken, the platform it runs in. Ruken is a name: keep it.

runtime_progress.note: Shown when the player's saved progress could not be loaded.

runtime_damaged.note: Shown when the game's files do not match, so this copy is damaged.

runtime_download.note: Shown when the game could not download a file it needs.

runtime_download_stalled.note: Shown when a download is taking very long.

runtime_unsupported.note: Shown when this device cannot run the game at all.

runtime_model_invalid.note: Shown when a 3D model file in the game is damaged. {file} is the file's name.

runtime_retry.note: Button on an error. Tries again.

runtime_continue.note: Button on an error. Goes on without loading the saved progress.

runtime_exit.note: Button on an error. Leaves the game and goes back to the app it runs in. {host} is that app's name.

runtime_quit.note: Button on an error on the desktop. Closes the game.

runtime_loading.note: Shown over the screen while the game loads.

runtime_slow.note: Shown over the loading screen when loading takes long.

runtime_context_lost.note: Shown when the picture stopped drawing. A button lets the player try again.

display_gate_title.note: Heading of the cover shown on a phone held sideways in a browser. Asks to play fullscreen.

display_gate_body.note: Text of the cover on a sideways phone. The browser's bar takes room; one tap hides it.

display_gate_go.note: Button on the cover on a sideways phone. Goes fullscreen.

display_gate_upright_title.note: Heading of the cover on a phone that cannot go fullscreen. Asks to hold the phone upright.

display_gate_upright_body.note: Text of that cover. Suggests adding the game to the Home Screen to play sideways.

display_rotate_portrait_title.note: Heading of the cover shown when a portrait game is held sideways.

display_rotate_landscape_title.note: Heading of the cover shown when a landscape game is held upright.

display_toast_text.note: A short tip at the top of the screen. The game runs on; turning the phone gives a bigger view.

display_toast_ok.note: Button on that tip. Closes it.

display_toast_dismiss.note: Name of the close button on that tip. Read aloud by screen readers.
